stock.description: M-Resources Group Limited, an investment holding company headquartered in Lai Chi Kok, Hong Kong, conducts a range of operations. These activities involve the sale of plantation and household products, the provision of financial services, and the distribution of accessories. The company adopted its current name in April 2021, having previously operated as IR Resources Limited.
